featured_reviews.name: Uma Harshe
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter has been learning BharatNatyam here, since she was 5 years old. Priya is not only a good dancer but also an excellent teacher. A concert is held every year by Dancing Yogi Academy. My daughter has been participating every year. She has almost overcome her stage fright and gained confidence thanks to Priya teacher.

featured_reviews.name: Arundhati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Priya is an exceptionally talented and dedicated dance teacher. A trained classical dancer, she brings depth, grace, and strong technique to her teaching while seamlessly blending Indian and Western dance forms. What truly sets her apart is her humility, patience, and passion for teaching students of all age groups—from young kids to adults.

Her classes are lively, enjoyable, and double up as a great workout.. The annual event is a wonderful platform for students to showcase their progress and confidence on stage, while also reflecting Priya’s hard work and commitment as a teacher.

DYA - Highly recommended for kids and adults looking to learn dance in a fun and pleasant environment.

featured_reviews.name: Mangesh Parulkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Priya has an amazing ability to make even the most ordinary dancers perform with confidence and grace. Dance has always been my biggest fear, but I had to perform at my sister’s wedding. Thanks to Priya, the couple dance turned out beautifully—she choreographed the steps so thoughtfully and made everything so easy to follow.

Her style is simple yet unique, and she creates such a comfortable environment that you never feel nervous or overwhelmed. She is especially wonderful with kids. I was truly surprised when my 4-year-old son performed on stage without a single mistake!

I highly recommend Priya, especially for children and for anyone who wants to quickly learn a dance for a special occasion—particularly couple performances.

PRERNA indeed is best experience ever.

featured_reviews.name: Dr.Pradnya Diwan
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 Star Review for DYA
I have had the pleasure of learning from my beloved Guru Priya and I can confidently say that she is an exceptional instructor! Her passion for dance is contagious, and she creates a welcoming and supportive environment for all students, regardless of skill level.
Her teaching style is both professional and encouraging. Her choreography is inspiring, and she takes the time to refine details, making sure every student shines.

I would also like to express immense gratitude to my beloved guru Priya for giving us an opportunity to perform in the annual concert, PRERANA of DYA. Hats off to her great efforts and dedication!

I highly recommend Priya to anyone looking to improve their skills, gain confidence, and most importantly—have fun while dancing.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the warm and inviting atmosphere at Dream big dance academy. From the moment I stepped in, I was greeted by a clean and friendly environment that instantly put me at ease.

One of the standout features of this studio is their teaching methods, which are incredibly easy to follow. Whether you're a beginner or have some experience, the instructors break down the steps in a way that's not only comprehensive but also enjoyable.

Speaking of instructors, I was blown away by the talent and expertise of our dance teacher. Their skills on the dance floor are truly remarkable, and their ability to impart knowledge and technique is unparalleled. Learning from such a well-seasoned dancer has been a privilege.

Moreover, the studio provides ample space for practice, allowing each individual to move freely and comfortably. Whether you're practicing solo or with a partner, there's enough room to unleash your creativity and perfect your moves.

Overall, I can't recommend Dream big dance academy enough. It's more than just a dance studio, it's a community where passion, skill, and camaraderie come together to create an unforgettable experience.

Not only is Radhika Tai herself one of the most graceful dancers, but also is the most meticulous, punctual and patient teacher, a mentor for things not just related to dance, she is in fact “Passion personifed”. She sets extremely creative challenges for students at regular intervals, for all age groups and all grades of experience in Katthak. There come along ample occasions and opportunities to perform on Stage, and implement what we learn, which makes it a ‘hands on’-kinda training, and this happens right from the beginners level-  that is the USP for this institute. Been a student for atleast last 18 years, I owe my happiness to this institute. My metamorphosis from a little school girl in two pigtails to a Doctor was catalysed by this fantastic place. Did not just make me a dancer- but helped shape my personality. I see the world in meters of DhaDhinDhinDha 😌- and trust me it surely is a much jouyous world! Thanks to Radhika tai❤️
